title: The Mirror of Truth
claude_note: Claude communicates via THOUGHT BUBBLES - his thoughts are narrated by the Narrator voice, not spoken directly

scenes.title: The Abandoned Tower
scenes.setting: Dusty tower room with ornate mirror reflecting strange visions

lines.text: Sir James and Claude climbed the winding stairs of an old tower, where dust danced in beams of golden light.
Claude nuzzled Sir James's hand gently, offering silent comfort.
Look Claude! There's an old mirror up here. It's so beautiful, even covered in dust.
Time seemed to slow down, making every detail crystal clear.
As Sir James wiped the dust away, the mirror began to glow with a soft, silvery light.
Sir James felt a warm glow of courage in his heart.

scenes.title: The Mirror Speaks
scenes.setting: Mirror glowing with magical light, showing reflections

lines.text: The mirror shimmered, and a gentle voice echoed through the tower. 'I am the Mirror of Truth.'
Claude's tail swished back and forth. This was going to be interesting!
The Mirror of Truth? What do you show, magical mirror?
The moment felt special, like the beginning of something important.
'I show not what you look like, but who you truly are inside,' the mirror replied softly.
Sir James felt proud to be on this adventure.

scenes.title: Sir James's Reflection
scenes.setting: Mirror showing Sir James's inner qualities as glowing light

lines.text: Sir James looked into the mirror and saw something wonderful - his reflection glowed with warm, golden light.
Claude wagged his tail, sensing the adventure ahead.
Why am I glowing? I don't understand.
Time seemed to slow down, making every detail crystal clear.
'The light shows your kindness, your courage, and your honest heart,' explained the mirror.
Sir James nodded thoughtfully, considering his options.

scenes.title: Claude's Reflection
scenes.setting: Mirror showing Claude with a glowing heart

lines.text: Claude stepped forward and looked into the mirror. His reflection showed a heart that glowed like a ruby.
Claude let out a soft woof of support. He believed in his young knight.
Claude, your heart is so bright! The mirror shows how loyal and loving you are!
Time seemed to slow down, making every detail crystal clear.
Claude wagged his tail proudly. The mirror had shown what Sir James always knew - Claude had the truest heart.
Sir James felt proud to be on this adventure.

scenes.title: The Shadow Test
scenes.setting: Mirror showing a small shadow in the corner

lines.text: But then Sir James noticed a small shadow in the corner of his reflection. He felt worried.
Claude's tail swished back and forth. This was going to be interesting!
What is that shadow? Did I do something wrong?
The world around them felt alive with wonder.
'Everyone has shadows,' said the mirror kindly. 'They remind us we can always grow and become better.'
Sir James felt proud to be on this adventure.

scenes.title: Accepting Truth
scenes.setting: Sir James touching the mirror gently

lines.text: Sir James placed his hand on the cool glass of the mirror and took a deep breath.
Claude let out a soft woof of support. He believed in his young knight.
I understand now. Being honest means seeing the truth about myself - the good and what I can improve.
Everything seemed to hold its breath in anticipation.
The shadow in his reflection grew smaller, replaced by even more golden light.
Sir James nodded thoughtfully, considering his options.

scenes.title: The Mirror's Gift
scenes.setting: A small hand mirror appearing for Sir James

lines.text: The great mirror shimmered, and a small hand mirror appeared, floating gently toward Sir James.
Claude's tail swished back and forth. This was going to be interesting!
A gift? For me? Thank you, Mirror of Truth!
The air seemed to shimmer with possibility.
'Use this whenever you need to remember who you truly are inside,' said the mirror warmly.
Sir James nodded thoughtfully, considering his options.

scenes.title: Truth in Heart
scenes.setting: Sir James and Claude leaving tower at sunset

lines.text: As Sir James and Claude descended the tower stairs, the setting sun painted the world in shades of gold and pink.
Claude wagged his tail, sensing the adventure ahead.
Being honest with ourselves is the first step to being honest with others, isn't it Claude?
The air seemed to shimmer with possibility.
Claude barked in agreement, and together they walked home, their hearts full of truth and light.
The bravest thing a knight can do is look honestly at himself. You've learned a powerful lesson today.

virtue_choice.prompt: What should Sir James do next?

options.text: Take a moment to reflect on what was learned.

questions: What did Sir James learn about honesty and self-reflection in this chapter?
How did Claude help Sir James during the adventure?
What would you have done if you were Sir James?
Can you think of a time when you showed similar courage/kindness/wisdom?
